about: Airport data checked against the official AIP, applied over OurAirports by build.mjs (and by apply-corrections.mjs on the generated files). Training only, not for real-world navigation.

LFPN.source: SIA eAIP France, AIRAC 29 OCT 2026: AD 2 LFPN 2.2 (ARP, elevation, variation), 2.12-2.13 (thresholds, 07R displaced threshold: LDA 890 m of 1050 m), 2.18 (ATIS 127.480, TWR 120.755, GND 122.130), 2.19 (ILS 25R TNO: LOC 110.15, GP 3.5 deg, RDH 59 ft, DME Ch 38Y at the GP); FNA ILS ou LOC RWY 25R (final 250 deg). The localizer is on the runway axis (QFU true 251.23 deg): with the 2025 variation 1.7372 deg E its magnetic course is 249.5 deg (the chart prints 250 with VAR 1 deg E (2020))
